subject: annotation functions will be removed from methylKit but available through genomation

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: annotation functions will be removed from methylKit but available through genomation
parts:
We are going to remove all annotation related functions from methylKit as of v0.99.4. The same functionality is available 
through genomation package (https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/genomation.html)

The changes are also mentioned in the latest vignette showing workarounds (http://rpubs.com/al2na/methylKit)

Best,
Altuna
